title: Generative_model
summary: A personal study repository implementing several generative model architectures (VAE, DDPM, CTGAN, CTAB-GAN) for tabular and general data synthesis. Its CTGAN/CTAB-GAN code copies rdt.transformers for column-wise normalization, and separate notebooks run SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, HMASynthesizer, and evaluation utilities (run_diagnostic, evaluate_quality) directly on demo datasets.
needs: Unclear whether CTGAN/코드구현/data_transformer.py is a verbatim vendored copy of the ctgan package or an independent reimplementation that reuses rdt.
